summary: All four requirements are implemented. REQ-1 is addressed in HomePage.tsx with animated wheat stalks and floating leaves in the hero section. REQ-2 is addressed in ProductCatalogPage.tsx (animated leaf divider, pollen particles) and BusinessProfilePage.tsx (animated vine/leaf border accents). REQ-3 is addressed in Footer.tsx with a scrolling agro-strip banner and animated wheat stalks overlay. REQ-4 is addressed in tailwind.config.js with at least seven new keyframe animations (sway, sway-slow, float-up, leaf-drift, grow-in, sprout-pulse, scroll-field, pollen-float). No missing requirements or hallucinated features of significance are identified.
